description: This source file defines classes and functions for training and using custom object detection models based on YOLOv3 and TinyYOLOv3 architectures. It includes classes for training models (`DetectionModelTrainer`) and for performing object detection on images and videos (`CustomObjectDetection`, `CustomVideoObjectDetection`). The code manages model loading, training configuration, inference, and detection result processing, referencing external modules for dataset loading, model architectures, loss computation, validation, and utility functions.

classes.name: DetectionModelTrainer
classes.description: Class for training object detection models using YOLOv3 or TinyYOLOv3 architectures.

classes.name: CustomObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on images using trained YOLOv3 or TinyYOLOv3 models.

classes.name: CustomVideoObjectDetection
classes.description: Class for performing object detection on videos or live streams using trained models.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to YOLOv3 for training or detection.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsTinyYOLOv3
methods.description: Sets the model type to TinyYOLOv3 for training or detection.

methods.name: setDataDirectory
methods.description: Sets the directory containing training/validation datasets in YOLO format.

methods.name: setTrainConfig
methods.description: Configures training parameters including object classes, batch size, epochs, and optional pretrained model.

methods.name: trainModel
methods.description: Starts the training process for the detection model.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the file path to the pretrained model weights.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the JSON configuration file containing labels and anchors.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model weights from the specified path.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromImage
methods.description: Performs object detection on a single image, returning detected objects and optionally saving or returning images.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromVideo
methods.description: Performs object detection on a video or live stream, with support for callbacks at various intervals.

methods.name: useCPU
methods.description: Forces the detection to run on CPU.
